name: WdBaselineAlignment
description: Specifies the vertical position of fonts on a line.

constants.name: wdBaselineAlignTop
constants.description: Align along top of each font.

constants.name: wdBaselineAlignCenter
constants.description: Align center points of each font.

constants.name: wdBaselineAlignBaseline
constants.description: Align to a baseline for the paragraph.

constants.name: wdBaselineAlignFarEast50
constants.description: Align using the baseline for Asian language font standards.

constants.name: wdBaselineAlignAuto
constants.description: Microsoft Word automatically adjusts the baseline font alignment.
